metadata.description: Official Claude plugins from Tokentide: the Tokentide API connector and the skills built on it.

plugins.name: tokentide
plugins.description: Use the Tokentide API from Claude: live tide prices, Low Tide, quotes and cost estimates, the model catalog, your balance and usage, and paid calls under your own price caps. Includes a skill that researches a product and turns it into short-form vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and X with Tokentide's models.
